title: Migrate from flake to devenv CLI
description: Replace the fragile devenv flake integration with the recommended flakeless devenv CLI project format while preserving packages, processes, direnv activation, and reproducible input pinning.
acceptance_criteria: devenv.yaml and devenv.lock replace flake.nix and flake.lock; the CLI shell works without PWD; devenv tests and project checks pass; direnv and README use the CLI workflow.
close_reason: Implemented devenv root-file override and verified evaluation with PWD removed
